# printf / scanf {.unnumbered}

*Every output below is what the program actually printed.*

## Conversions

| | type | prints |
|---|---|---|
| `%d` `%i` | `int` | `-42` |
| `%u` | `unsigned` | `42` |
| `%ld` | `long` | `1234567890` |
| `%lld` | `long long` | `9000000000` |
| `%zu` | `size_t` (`sizeof`, `strlen`) | `4` |
| `%f` | `double` *and* `float` | `2.718282` |
| `%e` | `double`, exponent | `2.718282e+00` |
| `%g` | `double`, shorter form | `2.71828` |
| `%c` | `char` | `A` |
| `%s` | string | `hi` |
| `%x` | `int`, hex | `ff` |
| `%o` | `int`, octal | `10` |
| `%p` | pointer — cast `(void *)p` | differs on every run |
| `%%` | literal `%` | `%` |

## Width and precision

| | |
|---|---|
| `%5d` | `[   42]` |
| `%-5d` | `[42   ]` |
| `%05d` | `[00042]` |
| `%.2f` | `[3.14]` |
| `%8.3f` | `[   3.142]` |
| `%.3s` | `[abc]` |

## printf vs scanf — the one that catches everyone

| | `printf` | `scanf` |
|---|---|---|
| `float` | `%f` | `%f` |
| `double` | `%f` | **`%lf`** |

## scanf rules

| Rule | |
|---|---|
| needs the address | `scanf("%d", &i)` |
| **except arrays** | `scanf("%19s", s)` — no `&` |
| always limit `%s` | `char s[50]` → `%49s` |
| `%s` stops at a space | reads one **word**, not a line |
| check the return | number of items filled |

```c
int i; double d; float f; char c; char s[20];
if (scanf("%d %lf %f %c %19s", &i, &d, &f, &c, s) != 5) return 1;
```

input `7 2.5 1.5 Z hello` →

```
i=7 d=2.500 f=1.500 c=Z s=hello
```

## Three mistakes `-Wall` catches

```c
scanf("%f", &d);   /* d is double  */   warning: expects 'float *' but argument is 'double *'
scanf("%d", i);    /* missing &    */   warning: expects 'int *'   but argument is 'int'
scanf("%s", &s);   /* & on array   */   warning: expects 'char *'  but argument is 'char (*)[20]'
```
